subject: ela
intro: Use voice and mood for effect.

items.prompt:
Active voice emphasizes the:
A) doer of the action
B) page count
C) punctuation

Which voice is usually more direct and concise?
A) active
B) passive
C) neither

'If I were you' uses the:
A) subjunctive mood
B) imperative mood
C) interrogative mood

PASSIVE voice is useful when:
A) the doer is unknown or you want to stress the receiver
B) you always want the shortest sentence
C) you never want to name an action
items.answer: A) the doer is unknown or you want to stress the receiver

solution.answer: A) the doer is unknown or you want to stress the receiver

items.prompt:
Why use the SUBJUNCTIVE in 'If I were in charge, I would change the rules'?
A) to express a hypothetical (not currently true) situation
B) to give a command
C) to ask a question
items.answer: A) to express a hypothetical (not currently true) situation

solution.answer: A) to express a hypothetical (not currently true) situation

items.prompt:
'Mistakes were made' is often criticized because the passive voice:
A) hides who is responsible
B) names the doer clearly
C) is a question

steps: No actor named. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A scientist writes, 'The samples were heated to 100°C.' The passive voice here is appropriate because:
A) the focus is on the process, not on who did it
B) the doer is the most important part
C) it is a command
items.answer: A) the focus is on the process, not on who did it

steps: Passive emphasizes the process. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) the focus is on the process, not on who did it

items.prompt:
Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive?
A) 'I wish I were taller.'
B) 'I wish I was taller.'
C) 'I wishes I were taller.'
